title: Aquatick
subtitle: Daily hydration tracker with beverage type charts, reminders, and health articles to build better water habits.

sections.description: Aquatick helps you track your daily fluid intake broken down by drink type, visualized as charts. It calculates your personal daily goal, sends reminders throughout the day, and offers health articles to build lasting hydration habits.
features: Track different beverage types separately with chart visualization (Vico)
Curated health articles fetched via Retrofit
Lottie animations for a polished UI experience
